data.summary:
**When:** [Opponent's Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase), as an enemy unit in [Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range) of one of your **BEAST SNAGGA** units is picked for a [Fall-back move](vsdata:core-rule/fall-back).

**Target:** That **BEAST SNAGGA** unit.

**Effect:** Whenever an enemy unit in Engagement Range of the unit is picked for a Fall-back move, it must pick [Desperate Escape](vsdata:core-rule/desperate-escape-2) as its mode. A **MONSTER** or **VEHICLE** unit escaping this way also makes 3 extra [hazard rolls](vsdata:core-rule/hazard-rolls) per **BEAST SNAGGA** unit in Engagement Range of it, with -1 to those rolls while it is **battle-shocked**.
